Here i'll share you a list of problems about data cleaning and manipulations, that i consider goods and needs a high level of skill to handle data, and the best way to solve it by me.

I'll use pyspark and python native functions to solve the problems.

If you're new with pyspark, i left you a tutorial to setup your pyspark environment

The first problem take a dataframe and "merge vertically". What i mean

  • Part 2 takes the phone columns and flat the sub dataframe selected to after convert in a list with unique values without nulls

Regex: Cleaning Phone Numbers

Like the previous problem, i import the nessesary functions that i need to create the dataframe, solve the problem and define the dataframe.

The dataframe has just one column and the phones may has phone extention with parenthesis or not, but i just want extract the raw number without '-' or spaces

The piece of code below detect the phone extention and remove it. That is a regex and it can explain in two parts. This parts are groups:

  • The first part is \+?\(?502\)?\s? and i enclosing in (), basically find for the 502 number with all symbol that are close to it, like +, one blank space, parenthesis or the first digit in the phone number

  • The second part is (\d{8})|(\d{4}-?\d{4}) enclosing in () too. In regex this is an 'or' that match between a sequence of eight digits and two pairs of sequences with four digits.

  • After make the match, just left the second group in a new column

The last part of this problem is just remove any symbol that isn't a number, but for my case just replace '-' by '' and i get
